# 4. The raw layer

The raw tables, what each column holds, and the SQL that loads the landed files into them, each table its own way (full, append or incremental). Run the loads from the project folder, after the files have landed.

## 4.1 Create the schemas and the raw tables

**Why:** Raw tables hold the data as it arrived, plus when it was loaded (`_ingested_at`) and from which batch (`_batch_id`). Nothing ever changes a raw row except the load. Every statement can run again safely.

## 4.2 Create the table that remembers loaded files

**Why:** Each load records the files it took, so running a load again never loads a file twice.

```sql
-- Generated by Murakumo: where loaded files are remembered, without Murakumo. Run it from the project folder.
create schema if not exists audit;
create table if not exists audit.loaded_files (table_name varchar, path varchar, size bigint, sha256 varchar, rows_ingested bigint, batch_id varchar, loaded_at timestamp);
```

```bash
duckdb commerce.duckdb < generated/guide/sql/load/00_audit.sql
```

- [ ] Create the table that remembers loaded files

## 4.3 Load raw_nyc_tlc.taxi_zone_lookup

**Why:** Reference list of TLC taxi zones, used to decode pickup and dropoff location IDs. Loaded `full`: Each run fetches the whole table, so the latest run's files replace it. Its files: `landing/nyc_tlc/taxi_zone_lookup/taxi_zone_lookup_*.jsonl`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LocationID | integer (INTEGER) | no | Taxi zone identifier. | primary key; internal |
| Borough | string (VARCHAR) | yes | New York City borough containing the zone. | internal; one of Bronx, Brooklyn, EWR, Manhattan, N/A, Queens, Staten Island, Unknown |
| Zone | string (VARCHAR) | yes | Neighbourhood or area name of the zone. | internal |
| service_zone | string (VARCHAR) | yes | TLC service area the zone belongs to. | internal; one of Airports, Boro Zone, EWR, N/A, Yellow Zone |

generated/guide/sql/load/01_raw_nyc_tlc__taxi_zone_lookup.sql:

```sql
-- Generated by Murakumo: load nyc_tlc.taxi_zone_lookup (full), without Murakumo. Run it from the project folder.

-- The files under landing/nyc_tlc/taxi_zone_lookup/ that were not loaded before.
-- Loaded in full: each run fetched the whole table, so only the latest run's files count.
create or replace temp table new_rows as
select cast("LocationID" as INTEGER) as "LocationID", cast("Borough" as VARCHAR) as "Borough", cast("Zone" as VARCHAR) as "Zone", cast(service_zone as VARCHAR) as service_zone, filename
from read_json('landing/nyc_tlc/taxi_zone_lookup/taxi_zone_lookup_*.jsonl', format = 'newline_delimited', filename = true, columns = {'LocationID': 'INTEGER', 'Borough': 'VARCHAR', 'Zone': 'VARCHAR', 'service_zone': 'VARCHAR'})
where regexp_extract(filename, '_(\d{8}T\d{12}Z)_', 1) = (select max(regexp_extract(file, '_(\d{8}T\d{12}Z)_', 1)) from glob('landing/nyc_tlc/taxi_zone_lookup/taxi_zone_lookup_*.jsonl'))
  and parse_filename(filename) not in (select parse_filename(path) from audit.loaded_files where table_name = 'taxi_zone_lookup');
-- When the latest run is new, its rows replace the table's.
delete from raw_nyc_tlc.taxi_zone_lookup where exists (select 1 from new_rows);
insert into raw_nyc_tlc.taxi_zone_lookup ("LocationID", "Borough", "Zone", service_zone, _ingested_at, _batch_id)
select "LocationID", "Borough", "Zone", service_zone, now(), parse_filename(filename) from new_rows;
-- Remember the files, so the next run skips them.
insert into audit.loaded_files (table_name, path, size, sha256, rows_ingested, batch_id, loaded_at)
select 'taxi_zone_lookup', filename, null, null, count(*), parse_filename(filename), now()
from new_rows group by filename;
drop table new_rows;
```

```bash
duckdb commerce.duckdb < generated/guide/sql/load/01_raw_nyc_tlc__taxi_zone_lookup.sql
```

## 4.4 Load raw_nyc_tlc.yellow_tripdata

**Why:** One row per completed yellow taxi trip, published monthly as Parquet. Loaded `append`: Each file not loaded before is added: nothing is ever replaced. Its files: `landing/nyc_tlc/yellow_tripdata/yellow_tripdata_*.jsonl`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| VendorID | integer (INTEGER) | yes | TPEP provider that supplied the record. | internal; one of 1, 2, 6, 7 |
| tpep_pickup_datetime | timestamp (TIMESTAMP) | no | Date and time the meter was engaged (local New York time). | internal |
